articles.title: Spain dominates the new FIFPro World XI with four players, without the Ballon d'Or
articles.standfirst: David Raya, Pau Cubarsí, Rodri and Lamine Yamal have been chosen by their own teammates among the eleven best players of last season, with Harry Kane's absence standing out
articles.summary: David Raya, Pau Cubarsí, Rodri and Lamine Yamal have been chosen by their own teammates among the eleven best players of last season, with Harry Kane's absence standing out
articles.body:
The Spanish National Team has been recognized for the World Cup won in the United States with the inclusion of four of its players in the FIFPro World XI . David Raya, Pau Cubarsí, Rodri Hernández and Lamine Yamal have been chosen by their own teammates among the best eleven players of last season.

In the midst of a World Cup year , voters have had to choose from the last 26 finalists the 11 best players of the past campaign. The previous edition was dominated by PSG , with as many as five footballers from Luis Enrique’s team. This season, four Spaniards feature in the FIFPro World XI: David Raya, Pau Cubarsí, Rodri Hernández and Lamine Yamal.

As in the previous season, there is still significant representation from the Parisian side, two-time Champions League winner , with Achraf Hakimi, Nuno Mendes and Vitinha.

On Real Madrid's side, the presence of Jude Bellingham and Kylian Mbappé stands out. In a lineup in which the absence of the brand-new Ballon d'Or winner, Harry Kane , is striking, the other two spots are filled by Erling Haaland and Leo Messi .

Therefore, the FIFPro 2026 World XI is as follows: David Raya; Achraf Hakimi, Pau Cubarsí, Nuno Mendes; Rodri, Vitinha, Bellingham; Messi, Yamal, Mbappé and Haaland.

David Raya has been the player who has accumulated the most votes across all positions . 51.9% of the footballers chose the Arsenal goalkeeper as the best of last season, far ahead of the runner-up; Courtois (38.6%). Among the defenders, Pau Cubarsí, with 26.8%, was only surpassed by Hakimi (40.9%).

Among the midfielders , Rodri leads the list with 33.1% , closely followed by Bellingham ( 31.3% ). And in the forwards area, 46% of the voters chose Mbappé , and 37.4% chose Lamine Yamal . Behind them, Messi (29.5%) and Haaland (28.4%) left out Harry Kane (27.6%), in a lineup with four attackers .

An unprecedented situation

The absence of Bayern Munich 's " number nine " is something extraordinary . For the first time since this award began in 2005 , the winner of the Ballon d'Or that same year has not been included afterward in the ideal FIFPro team.

The voting was carried out by 19,806 footballers from 73 countries who assessed "their performances between 4 August 2025 and 19 July 2026 , both inclusive, during which they must have played at least 30 official matches".

With the four appearances in this new edition, Spain widens its lead as the country with the highest number of appearances in the Men's World XI , with 53 selections shared among 17 players . In addition, Lamine Yamal becomes the first player in history to appear for the second time in the FIFPro World XI before the age of 20.

articles.title: "We're going to take advantage of it": Araújo's provocative remark about Messi before Argentina-Uruguay that heats up the friendly
articles.standfirst: The Uruguayan defender, who shared a locker room with the former Argentine captain at Barcelona, anticipated how La Celeste will try to take advantage of the No. 10's absence and left a remark that fired up the buildup to the clásico at La Bombonera.
articles.summary: The Uruguayan defender, who shared a locker room with the former Argentine captain at Barcelona, anticipated how La Celeste will try to take advantage of the No. 10's absence and left a remark that fired up the buildup to the clásico at La Bombonera.
articles.body:
The Argentina national team will face a special test this Friday, November 13, when it hosts Uruguay at La Bombonera. It will be its first match after Lionel Messi 's farewell from the national team and, ahead of the game, people from La Celeste have already started heating up the Río de la Plata clásico with controversial statements.

One of those who spoke was Ronald Araújo, who knows the Argentine captain very well from having shared a dressing room with him at Barcelona. The Uruguayan defender did not avoid the subject of his absence and issued a warning that quickly drew attention: "In the end they lost the best player in the world, and we're going to take advantage of that."

Araújo's warning to the Argentina national team over Messi

The footballer made it clear that Uruguay will try to take advantage of the Albiceleste's new reality. However, he also acknowledged that Lionel Scaloni's team retains significant pedigree and that it will not be easy to face them. "They have great players, they have young players with a lot of quality, they are a great powerhouse", he said.

Araújo also highlighted the difficulty of facing Argentina and anticipated that Uruguay will seek to impose its style of play . "All matches against Argentina are difficult, but we are going to show our football and continue growing as a national team" added the defender, who is preparing for one of the most attractive matches of the FIFA international break.

Araújo will have a special duel with Alexis Mac Allister

The clásico will also have a particular twist for the Uruguayan defender: on the other side will be Alexis Mac Allister, his teammate at Liverpool. Araújo acknowledged that there had already been some joking between the two footballers ahead of the match. "We've already teased each other a little," he said, referring to the clash with his eyes on a duel that will have a special edge because it is Scaloni's first match without Messi.

The match will mark the beginning of a new era for the Argentine national team, which will have to face its commitments without the presence of its historic captain.

After the match against Uruguay, Scaloni's team will face Costa Rica on Tuesday, November 17, in Córdoba.

While Argentina will seek to show that it remains competitive without Messi, Uruguay will arrive hoping to take advantage of the new scenario.

articles.title: Shae Cruyff, Johan's grandson, called up by the United States
articles.standfirst: The legacy of the former Dutch player continues: he is an under-18 international
articles.summary: The legacy of the former Dutch player continues: he is an under-18 international
articles.body:
The surname Cruyff remains linked to the world of football. The legacy of the legendary former player and former coach, who passed away in 2016, lives on. Following the career of his son, Jordi, it is now his grandson Shea who is taking important steps in the sport: he has been called up to the United States under-18 national team.

Shea Cruyff-Beane, the youngest son of Chantal Cruyff, was called up in recent hours by the American national team, which will play two matches. Johan's grandson, who plays as a midfielder, is part of the youth ranks of Nàstic de Tarragona.

Shea holds three nationalities: Spain (where he was born), the Netherlands (his maternal family's country of origin), and the United States (his father's origin). He has now been called up by the American U18 team, but he could still change his national team in the future.

Football has always been a part of Shea 's life, since he is not only the grandson and nephew of professionals in this sport, but his father, Todd Beane, played for Dartmouth College, in the first division of the NCAA, and even went on to play professionally in his country.

The United States U18 team will face Portugal and Norway in the Lusitanian country.

articles.title: Pochettino accused of using USMNT “losers” to land Manchester United job: “He was just pretending”
articles.standfirst: Harsh article by Brian T. Smith in TalkSport against the United States national team coach
articles.summary: Harsh article by Brian T. Smith in TalkSport against the United States national team coach
articles.body:
The more than likely arrival of Mauricio Pochettino to the Manchester United bench, and the consequent breaking of the agreement the Argentine coach had with the United States national team until 2030, is one of the topics of the day.

Among all the published articles, the opinion column written this Wednesday by Brian T. Smith in TalkSport stands out, in which the author claims that "Mauricio Pochettino used the US national team's "losers""... to land his dream job".

Mauricio Pochettino told everyone who would listen that this moment would come. The big question for the United States men's national team is whether the U.S. Soccer Federation was smart enough to prepare for the inevitable , Brian T. Smith asks.

Pochettino's objective was always the Premier League

In the article, the author recalls that Pochettino always wanted what is about to happen: to return to the Premier League after the World Cup . "Now focused on the United States national team, perhaps one day I will return to the Premier League ," he said in a previous interview with TalkSport.

"The reality was that Pochettino fell frustratingly short with Christian Pulisic, Tyler Adams, Chris Richards, Christian Pulisic and a group of talents that was supposed to be the best U.S. soccer had ever produced ," criticizes Smith, who believes that Pochettino's interest in developing U.S. soccer was fictitious , as the Federation promised after the renewal.

Manchester United is ready to pay the $10 million release clause in the coach's contract , which was in force until 2030 before becoming worthless paper.

A problem for USMNT: replacement sought

" Pochettino was only acting when he pretended to love the United States national team . Which team would you rather manage: Manchester United or the United States national team?", he quips.

"Until soccer becomes a major sport in the United States, the search for a head coach truly committed to the United States will always be the same ," the article predicts.

"The United States national soccer team will have been nothing more than a springboard to something bigger and better on a brighter stage ," Smith concludes.

articles.title: Video resurfaces showing prime Cristiano Ronaldo jumping higher than NBA players
articles.summary: A resurfaced video shared by Polymarket Sports on X has renewed attention on Cristiano Ronaldo's extraordinary jumping ability during the peak of his soccer career. The Portuguese superstar became famous for spectacular headers that appeared to defy gravity, prompting comparisons with professional NBA players. Biomechanical studies and footage analyses suggest that his vertical leap could match or exceed that of many basketball players, although comparisons depend on the measurement method.
articles.body:
A resurfaced video shared by Polymarket Sports on X has renewed attention on Cristiano Ronaldo's extraordinary jumping ability during the peak of his soccer career. The Portuguese superstar became famous for spectacular headers that appeared to defy gravity, prompting comparisons with professional NBA players. Biomechanical studies and footage analyses suggest that his vertical leap could match or exceed that of many basketball players, although comparisons depend on the measurement method.

One of Ronaldo's most famous jumps occurred on February 13, 2013, when he scored for Real Madrid against Manchester United in the Champions League. A computer-based analysis by Spanish television estimated that his head reached 2.93 meters, approximately 9 feet 7 inches, above the ground. That is only 12 centimeters below the height of a regulation basketball hoop. Importantly, this figure represents the height of his head, not the distance his body rose from the ground.

articles.title: Pep Guardiola emerges as shock USMNT target amid Manchester United domino effect
articles.standfirst: If Manchester United pulls the trigger on Pochettino, US Soccer is ready to swing for the absolute fences. Could Pep Guardiola really be heading to the USMNT?
articles.summary: If Manchester United pulls the trigger on Pochettino, US Soccer is ready to swing for the absolute fences. Could Pep Guardiola really be heading to the USMNT?
articles.body:
On the verge of beginning the quarterfinal round of the Concacaf Nations League , the United States national team is going through a turbulent moment, as its project toward 2030 could be altered.

Their coach Mauricio Pochettino , who was retained despite the poor results prior to the 2026 World Cup , where he was eliminated in the round of 16, is the main target of Manchester United to rebuild a season in which they are in the relegation zone after 10 matchdays with Michael Carrick in charge.

Pep Guardiola, an option for the United States?

In what appears to be an imminent departure of the Argentine manager to the Premier League , where he stood out with Tottenham , a name of global significance is already beginning to emerge.

According to information from The Athletic, “ US Soccer is expected to make Pep Guardiola a top target to replace Mauricio Pochettino if the men’s national team coach leaves for Manchester United,” reports the sports outlet of The New York Times.

This is not the first time that the U.S. federation has intended to be able to hire the former Manchester City coach, since it also had him on its list ahead of the 2022 Qatar World Cup , The Athletic adds.

Guardiola has shown interest in the United States

Guardiola, who lived in New York after leaving Barcelona in 2012 and before joining Bayern Munich in 2013, has shown interest in Team USA in the past.

“ The United States is fascinating for trying to build a project over many years and being able to take the national team to the next level . The potential of the United States is there, because of the large number of people and sports,” he said in 2024.

Team USA faces Haiti in the quarterfinals of the Concacaf Nations League next Saturday away in Jamaica, where the Mexican National Team will also play; the Haitians cannot play in their country due to the turbulent political situation, and they host the second leg on Tuesday in Cincinnati. These matches are expected to be managed by Pochettino, and then the search for the new head coach would begin.

Rafa Márquez could come up against his coach from Barcelona

If this supposed possibility were to materialize, Rafa Márquez could face Joseph Guardiola for the first time as a coach, and it would be in a Mexico vs United States . Both were together at FC Barcelona between 2008 and 2010, the first years as head coach of the first team for the former Dorados de Sinaloa player.

Although it looks complicated, due to the Catalan's desire to rest and because of the refusal he gave to Italy this very summer, U.S. Soccer is in no rush this year to appoint a coach, since after this FIFA window its next matches are not until March 2027, which gives them more time to convince a high-profile coach, among whom Guardiola should be, according to reports this Wednesday.

articles.title: Former Brazil star Adriano shows he's still got it while playing street soccer in a humble neighborhood
articles.summary: Former Brazilian international Adriano Leite Ribeiro, famously nicknamed The Emperor, has gone viral after footage showed him performing an impressive series of soccer tricks on a street in Brazil. The video circulated widely on November 10 and 11, 2026, reminding fans of the technical ability that once made him one of the world's most feared strikers.
articles.body:
Former Brazilian international Adriano Leite Ribeiro, famously nicknamed The Emperor, has gone viral after footage showed him performing an impressive series of soccer tricks on a street in Brazil. The video circulated widely on November 10 and 11, 2026, reminding fans of the technical ability that once made him one of the world's most feared strikers.

Appearing shirtless and wearing shorts and flip-flops, the 44-year-old former Inter Milan striker completed 32 consecutive touches without letting the ball hit the ground. His demonstration included balancing the ball on his head and moving it between his legs, attracting admiration from viewers who remembered his playing days.

Adriano enjoyed the peak of his career at Inter Milan, where he won domestic trophies and became famous for his powerful left foot. He also played a decisive role in Brazil's 2004 Copa América victory, finishing as the tournament's leading scorer with seven goals and scoring a late equalizer against Argentina in the final. His career was later affected by injuries and personal struggles, and he retired professionally in 2016.

articles.title: USMNT's dream is Pep Guardiola, but a coach linked to Cristiano Ronaldo could be chosen
articles.standfirst: Speculation continues about the new national team coach following Mauricio Pochettino's departure
articles.summary: Speculation continues about the new national team coach following Mauricio Pochettino's departure
articles.body:
Once Mauricio Pochettino 's signing by Manchester United has been officially confirmed, it remains to be seen who will be in charge of filling the position that the argentine coach will leave vacant at the helm of the United States national team .

"According to TalkSport, the United States Soccer Federation wants Pep Guardiola to replace Mauricio Pochettino," but the truth is that everything indicates that this possibility is unlikely to happen.

Pep Guardiola's intentions

The Spanish coach, formerly of Barcelona , Bayern , and Manchester City , is currently without a team and would be a top-level signing for U.S. soccer, but Guardiola's intentions seem clear: to rest.

"After my contract with City, I’m going to stop. I’m sure. I don’t know if I’m going to retire, but I’m going to take a break," he said more than a year ago when he was still in charge of the Citizens team.

There are also many doubts that the USMNT project is the one that could convince Guardiola to break his plans and return to coaching. Nor that he wants to manage a national team, after having developed his entire career in club football.

Roberto Martínez, a more realistic option

Another of the candidates already being mentioned for the position is Roberto Martínez , Cristiano Ronaldo's former coach with the Portugal national team during the last World Cup. The Spanish manager is currently without a team, but his profile could fit the role: he speaks English perfectly and has managed two top-level national teams such as Portugal and Belgium, in addition to having Premier League experience.

articles.standfirst: The Argentine manager has decided to bring his spell in charge of the U.S. national team to an end to take the reins at the helm at Old Trafford
articles.summary: The Argentine manager has decided to bring his spell in charge of the U.S. national team to an end to take the reins at the helm at Old Trafford
articles.body:
The football world has woken up to one of the biggest bombshells in international dugouts in recent times. Mauricio Pochettino has decided to make a radical turn in his professional career by accepting the formal offer to become the new head coach of Manchester United, bringing his time in charge of the United States men's national soccer team to an early end (USMNT).

The news, which was confirmed simultaneously by various specialized outlets such as Infobae and El Universo, reveals th at the former Chelsea and Tottenham manager will assume his new duties at the English club starting next November 18 . This decision comes as a surprise to insiders and outsiders alike, given that the tactician had been leading the North American side's preparation process with the aim of consolidating an attacking identity for the future.

During his tenure at the helm of the U.S. national team, Pochettino managed to instill character and led the team to the Round of 16 of the FIFA World Cup , showing flashes of good football and a competitive structure. However, the call from the "Red Devils" — who were looking for a high-profile leader after Michael Carrick's departure — proved to be an opportunity the South American coach could not turn down.

The bittersweet farewell to the Stars and Stripes bench

According to reports issued by outlets such as RPP and the platform Tribuna, Pochettino’s departure will take place immediately once the current international break concludes . The United States Soccer Federation (USSF) agreed on the terms to release the coach and his entire coaching staff after the official fixtures scheduled against Haiti, which will be played on November 14 and 17.

Facing this imminent departure, the Argentine coach himself wanted to dedicate a few words of thanks to the fans and the American management, highlighting the pride that representing the country meant. In statements reported by the international press, Pochettino confessed with deep emotion: “It was one of the greatest honors of my career” , adding that his time with the national team and the affection he received will always hold a very special place in their hearts.

A new giant in the Premier League and the details of the deal

For its part, the iusport portal detailed the legal and operational terms of the Argentine's move to English football. Manchester United made official that the link will formally begin on November 18, once the strategist is fully released from his international responsibilities with the U.S. federation .

Pochettino arrives at Old Trafford backed by a solid track record in European football that includes notable spells with Espanyol of Barcelona, Southampton—where he broke historic points records—and five memorable seasons at Tottenham Hotspur, the club he led to the historic 2019 UEFA Champions League final. Likewise, his recent experience managing Paris Saint-Germain in France and Chelsea in the Premier League gives him the ideal credentials to set Manchester’s course right .

The enormous challenge of restoring glory to Old Trafford

The English club has placed a strong bet on Pochettino's ability to develop young talents and forge high-performance squads, qualities that the board considers essential to compete at the highest level both in the Premier League and in European competitions. The urgency at Old Trafford is absolute after an inconsistent start to the season that accelerated the changes in the technical leadership.

With his arrival, United fans hope to witness that hallmark brand of attacking, high-intensity football that has accompanied the coach throughout his career in England. The challenge is no small one, but the Argentine tactician has proven to be accustomed to taking on the most demanding challenges under the intense scrutiny of the British media .

Meanwhile, the United States Federation is already working against the clock in the search for a guaranteed replacement to continue the project started by the Argentine, aware that the upcoming international commitments leave no respite. The Pochettino era in North America has come to an end, but his indelible mark on the region's football will remain intact .

articles.title: Pochettino's Manchester United prepares €80 million to snatch a gem from Real Madrid
articles.standfirst: The English side is looking to pull off a masterstroke in the European market under the guidance of its new Argentine strategist
articles.summary: The English side is looking to pull off a masterstroke in the European market under the guidance of its new Argentine strategist
articles.body:
Mauricio Pochettino has officially taken over as head coach of Manchester United , bringing his time in charge of the United States national team to an end after an agreement that included the payment of his release clause. The coach from Santa Fe arrives at Old Trafford with the monumental task of getting a sleeping giant back on track, one that is going through one of the most turbulent periods in its recent history in the English league.

Given this landscape of profound sporting restructuring, the Red Devils' board is already working ahead of the upcoming transfer windows with the aim of refreshing the squad and surrounding its stars with game-changing talent . Competitive urgency demands bold moves and short- and long-term planning to return the club to the top of the continent.

Amid this rebuilding scenario, various journalistic reports from outlets such as Clarín and Infobae have begun to strongly link one of the top emerging stars of the Argentina National Team with the Mancunian bench , generating great anticipation within the international football scene.

A Champions League executioner who captivates Old Trafford

The protagonist of these rumors is Nico Paz , the talented attacking midfielder who is shining brightly for Como in Italy's Serie A under the guidance of Cesc Fàbregas . Reports published by outlets such as Radio Mitre and Urgente24 detail that Manchester United's interest intensified notably after the young midfielder's display in Europe's top club competition .

Just a few weeks ago, in a match corresponding to the UEFA Champions League group stage, the skillful left-footer delivered a memorable performance by scoring a brace in the Italian side's emphatic 4-1 thrashing of Manchester United itself . That display of talent left the English club's executives and coaching staff open-mouthed, and they now see him as the ideal heir and generational replacement for Bruno Fernandes.

Real Madrid's shadow and the financial battle

However, the operation does not appear feasible due to the complex contractual web linking the footballer to Real Madrid . As analyses from the international press and specialized outlets have pointed out, the Merengue club reserved a buyback option set at 80 million euros , which can only be exercised within a strict period during the summer transfer window, specifically between July 1 and 15, 2027.

It should be remembered that the White House already tried to bring back its former prospect last summer at the express request of José Mourinho, but the player himself chose to prioritize staying in Italy in order to consolidate his leading role . In addition, Como made a historic financial effort of close to 60 million euros to acquire 100% of his rights, considerably raising the bar for any club interested in his transfer.

Pochettino's trump card and the English raid plan

Aware of these obstacles, Manchester United would be willing to put a figure close to or above 80 million euros on the table to get ahead of any move by Real Madrid and secure the signing before the Los Blancos clause comes into effect. The presence of Mauricio Pochettino as a fellow countryman and the man ultimately in charge of the sporting project stands out as a key factor in enticing the player.

While Bruno Fernandes' future continues to raise questions amid the lack of an agreement over his contract renewal, Manchester United are accelerating their institutional machinery . The possibility of a change of scenery to the Premier League appeals to the player's camp, although the final outcome will depend both on Como's stance and on the intentions of the Madrid side .

The transfer market promises high drama and the name of the young Argentine gem will continue to dominate headlines as Europe’s giants battle to secure his services. The fight for the marquee signing is officially underway.

articles.title: Harry Kane stuns NFL fans with insane 68-yard field goal
articles.summary: Harry Kane is used to making headlines for scoring spectacular goals, but the Bayern Munich superstar has found a completely different way to surprise sports fans: kicking a football through the uprights from an astonishing distance. A video shared by the Bundesliga has sparked a social media frenzy after showing the England international attempting an NFL-style field goal from 68 yards. The clip immediately caught the attention of football fans on both sides of the Atlantic, with some wondering whether the footage was generated using artificial intelligence and others convinced that Kane genuinely has the leg strength to compete with professional NFL kickers. The spectacle is particularly interesting because Kane’s fascination with American football is no secret. The Bayern striker has repeatedly expressed admiration for the NFL, has previously demonstrated his ability to kick long-distance field goals and has even discussed the possibility of becoming a professional kicker after retiring from soccer.

articles.title: Mexico vs. Jamaica: El Tri exposes its weaknesses in costly defeat
articles.standfirst: Mexico endured a night to forget in Kingston and will now have to find answers on home soil.
articles.summary: Mexico endured a night to forget in Kingston and will now have to find answers on home soil.
articles.body:
Mexico's national team is still far from delivering the excitement and confidence it inspired during the World Cup. Saturday's match against Jamaica, November 14, made that clear once again . Rafael Márquez's side made costly mistakes that left it chasing the game and ultimately struggling to recover from a match that slipped out of its hands.

The first leg of the Concacaf Nations League quarterfinals took place at the National Stadium in Kingston and marked Márquez's first official match in charge of El Tri after four friendlies.

Jamaica capitalizes on Mexico's mistakes and puts El Tri on the ropes

Mexico had its moments going forward and managed to threaten the opposing goal, but trying to take control of a match is one thing; turning that pressure into goals is another. Julián Quiñones had one of Mexico's clearest chances to take the lead, but he was unable to beat the Jamaican goalkeeper .

The lack of finishing became even more costly once the defensive mistakes began. In the 27th minute, a corner kick ended with Jesús Gallardo deflecting the ball into his own net . The own goal gave Jamaica the lead and left Mexico searching for an answer that never came before halftime.

The second half brought no relief. Just one minute after the restart, in the 46th minute, Renaldo Cephas got past Israel Reyes and beat Raúl Rangel to make it 2-0 . Mexico had no answer for Jamaica's attacks, and before the visitors could regroup, they were dealt another blow.

In the 59th minute, the referee went to VAR to review a foul by Gallardo inside the box and awarded a penalty. Richard King stepped up in the 63rd minute and converted to make it 3-0 . Within minutes, Mexico had gone from facing a difficult challenge to fighting for survival.

Gilberto Mora and Julián Quiñones spark Mexico's comeback when it seemed too late

With a three-goal deficit to overcome, Márquez turned to his bench in search of a change. Alexis Vega, Jesús Corona and Santiago Sandoval came on to give Mexico's attack a different look, and the team finally found the response it had been missing.

Gilberto Mora was the first to step up . In the 70th minute, the young midfielder fired a low shot from outside the box and found the back of the net, giving El Tri a much-needed glimmer of hope.

The comeback gained momentum 11 minutes later. After a foul on Sandoval inside the penalty area, Mexico was awarded a spot kick, which Julián Quiñones converted to make it 3-2. What had looked like a blowout suddenly became a much tighter contest , with Mexico pushing for an equalizer that ultimately never came.

Those two goals changed the complexion of the tie and prevented Mexico from returning home facing an even bigger deficit. Still, they also left a difficult question hanging over the team: why did it take being backed into a corner to find the finishing touch that had been missing for most of the night?

Mexico faces Jamaica again in Monterrey with a comeback on the line

The tie is far from over. The second leg will take place on Tuesday, November 17, at Estadio BBVA in Monterrey, Nuevo León , where El Tri will have a chance to turn the series around and secure a place in the Concacaf Nations League semifinals.

But Mexico cannot rely on another late surge. The team will need to show a much more solid version of itself, particularly on defense, while making the most of its scoring opportunities from the opening whistle. The one-goal difference keeps the tie alive, but Jamaica has already shown just how much damage it can do.

articles.title: Massive brawl erupts between New York Red Bulls and Club América in five-red-card showdown
articles.summary: A spirited international exhibition between the New York Red Bulls and Club América ended in chaos Saturday night, as a massive on-field brawl turned a friendly into an ugly confrontation involving flying punches, vicious kicks, five red cards and objects thrown by fans. The Red Bulls secured a 1-0 victory at Sports Illustrated Stadium in New Jersey, but the result quickly became an afterthought after tempers boiled over in the 85th minute. A late confrontation near the end line escalated into an all-out melee, with players from both teams abandoning the soccer match to exchange punches, kicks and shoves. It began as an isolated altercation but it rapidly spread across the pitch, forcing officials and members of both coaching staffs to intervene as they attempted to separate the players.

articles.title: Neymar denies a relationship with Vinicius's ex-girlfriend: "Let me play poker in peace"
articles.standfirst: The Santos forward responds on Instagram to rumors about Virginia Fonseca after the two were both at a private party in São Paulo.
articles.summary: The Santos forward responds on Instagram to rumors about Virginia Fonseca after the two were both at a private party in São Paulo.
articles.body:
Now let me play poker in peace". With that phrase, Neymar ended the message in which he denied being in a relationship with Virginia Fonseca , the ex-partner of Vinicius Júnior.

The Santos forward posted the denial on his Instagram stories after the rumor spread in Brazil. "I don't normally do this kind of thing through stories, but this time they've gone too far," he wrote on social media.

The rumor arose from a report by Fábia Oliveira in Metrópoles . The journalist said that Neymar and Virginia were both at a private party in São Paulo on November 6 and that the influencer danced next to the footballer while he was sitting on a sofa. According to A Bola, representatives for both denied that there was a relationship. Neymar's camp maintained that "the published information is false and does not correspond to the reality of the facts." Virginia's team described the reports of an alleged relationship as "completely false" and criticized the speculation about her private life being presented as fact.

Neymar responds in the first person

Hours after the denials, the Santos player spoke out. "There's a story going around claiming that there is a relationship between another person and me, and I deny it!" he wrote on Instagram. "My team has already issued a statement, but I had to step in personally to put an end to this matter!"

Virginia Fonseca and Vinicius Júnior had resumed their relationship in July, two months after their first breakup. When confirming the latest separation, the influencer's team stated that it was a mutual decision.

articles.title: Violence erupts in Brazilian women’s soccer final as Corinthians and Ferroviária face fallout
articles.standfirst: Referee Jéssica Aparecida Milani attempted to intervene, but the situation escalated before she could restore order
articles.summary: Referee Jéssica Aparecida Milani attempted to intervene, but the situation escalated before she could restore order
articles.body:
A championship celebration turned into an ugly scene in Brazilian women’s soccer after the Under-20 final between Ferroviária and Corinthians descended into a massive on-field brawl involving players, coaching staff and members of both teams.

The incident occurred Sunday at Fonte Luminosa Stadium in Araraquara, São Paulo , during the final of the São Paulo Women’s Under-20 Championship . A celebration of young talent and the development of women’s soccer instead became the center of controversy after a confrontation escalated into physical violence.

Ferroviária was leading 2-0 when tensions boiled over in the 31st minute of the second half. The situation began after Ferroviária player Miga was fouled by Corinthians’ Gabi Jordi. Miga responded by kicking her opponent, triggering a confrontation that quickly spread across the field.

Referee Jéssica Aparecida Milani attempted to intervene, but the situation escalated before she could restore order. Corinthians midfielder Mel entered the confrontation and was punched by Miga , sending her to the ground.

The incident also involved Corinthians head coach Júlia Passero , who moved toward Miga while the Ferroviária player was being restrained by her teammates. Both were subsequently sent off. Emy, a Corinthians forward who was on the substitutes’ bench, also received a red card.

Without VAR available, referee Milani had to gather with other match officials on the pitch to discuss the incidents and determine the disciplinary decisions. The confrontation overshadowed Ferroviária’s victory and prompted strong reactions from the clubs, the São Paulo Football Federation (FPF) and Brazil’s Ministry of Sport.

Corinthians plans police report after player is punched

One of the most concerning moments involved Mel, who was knocked to the ground after being punched by Miga. Corinthians announced that it intends to file a police report regarding the incident, signaling that the controversy could extend beyond the disciplinary proceedings within Brazilian soccer.

The club’s response adds another dimension to an already serious situation, particularly because the match involved players competing in a youth development category.

Ferroviária also announced that it would pursue appropriate legal action concerning the conduct of Corinthians coach Júlia Passero , accusing her of contributing to the violence rather than attempting to calm the situation. The two clubs have therefore taken opposing positions regarding responsibility for the confrontation, while both face scrutiny over the events that unfolded.

Ferroviária condemns violence but promises support for Miga

Ferroviária issued a statement through its women’s football organization, Guerreiras Grenás, expressing its rejection of violence while confirming that Miga would face internal disciplinary measures. The club acknowledged the seriousness of the player’s actions and said she would receive medical and psychological assistance as part of its commitment to developing young athletes.

Ferroviária emphasized that it does not tolerate violence regardless of who commits it or the circumstances surrounding an incident. However, the organization also stressed the importance of recognizing that the players involved are young athletes still undergoing personal and professional development.

The club argued that youth soccer should consider the broader challenges faced by female athletes, including sexism, misogyny and social exclusion. It maintained that disciplinary accountability and appropriate support should go hand in hand. Ferroviária also criticized Passero’s involvement in the confrontation, arguing that a coach should serve as a role model and help prevent situations from escalating, rather than becoming involved in physical altercations.

The club confirmed that it would take appropriate legal action regarding the coach’s conduct. Despite the controversy, Ferroviária also highlighted its achievements throughout the competition. The team finished the tournament undefeated, recording 15 victories and one draw to secure the championship.

São Paulo Football Federation and Ministry of Sport condemn incident

The controversy prompted an immediate response from the São Paulo Football Federation , which strongly condemned the violence witnessed during the final.

The FPF described the aggressive behavior as incompatible with the values of sport and emphasized that such incidents cannot be tolerated, particularly in women’s soccer, which continues to fight for greater recognition, visibility and investment.

The federation also confirmed that it would monitor developments and forward the case to the appropriate sports justice authorities for investigation and possible sanctions. Brazil’s Ministry of Sport also expressed its disappointment, stressing that violence has no place in sporting competitions.

The government agency was particularly concerned that the confrontation occurred during a women’s youth competition, where athletes should be able to develop their skills in a safe and supportive environment. The ministry called for a proper investigation and appropriate measures against those responsible, reaffirming its commitment to promoting respect, inclusion and safety in Brazilian sports.

articles.title: Mauricio Pochettino sends a message to Guardiola and encourages him to take the reins of the USMNT
articles.standfirst: The Argentine believes that Pep Guardiola would find the ideal setting to manage the U.S. national team, just as he prepares to begin a new chapter at Manchester United
articles.summary: The Argentine believes that Pep Guardiola would find the ideal setting to manage the U.S. national team, just as he prepares to begin a new chapter at Manchester United
articles.body:
The future of the United States national team is beginning to raise questions following the departure of Mauricio Pochettino , who will leave the North American side’s bench to take on a new challenge in English football. His destination will be Manchester United , an opportunity that marks his return to the Premier League and that also opens the search for a new head coach for the U.S. team .

Amid that scenario, the Argentine coach surprised many by speaking about who should take his place . His candidate is none other than Pep Guardiola , who is currently without a team after ending his stint as Manchester City's manager. Pochettino not only believes that the Spaniard has the necessary qualities, but also that the timing is especially favorable for him to accept the challenge .

The recommendation has a particular ingredient: Guardiola and Pochettino had already spoken about the Argentine's professional future . In fact, a conversation between the two would have influenced the South American's decision to return to club football and accept Manchester United's proposal. Now, the former Tottenham manager is returning the favor with advice that puts the Catalan coach at the center of the international stage .

Pochettino points to Guardiola as his successor

In statements reported by ESPN and published by GOAL, Pochettino was emphatic in assessing the possibility of Guardiola taking charge of the United States . The Argentine believes that the federation is going through a positive period and that the next head coach will find a structure with the conditions needed to develop an ambitious project.

"It is the perfect time to join the United States Federation. Everything is on the right track and headed in the right direction" , explained the coach, who also directly encouraged the Spaniard to accept a possible offer. In his view, the squad has players who could adapt to the former Manchester City coach's playing ideas.

Pochettino also defended the prestige the position has gained in recent years. His experience leading the U.S. national team allows him to appreciate the growth of the sporting structure , the facilities, and the available talent. That is why he believes that managing the United States could represent an attractive opportunity for a top-level coach.

Guardiola's response would not be what USMNT expects

However, Pochettino’s enthusiasm does not guarantee that Guardiola is willing to accept the challenge. According to The Telegraph, the Catalan coach would not be open to becoming the United States national team manager and would be determined to reject any offer that might come from the federation.

The information, later reported by Flashscore, puts the brakes on the expectations that had been building around his name. Although his status as a coach without a team fuels speculation, there is no confirmation of official negotiations between Guardiola and the U.S. national team .

That does not mean the coach has ruled out forever the possibility of managing a national team. The difference lies in the timing and the project: for now, the U.S. option does not seem to be among his priorities , despite the public recommendation of the man who until recently occupied that bench.

The conversation that changed Pochettino's plans

The relationship between the two coaches was also made evident by a conversation they had during a match in September. According to what Pochettino told The Telegraph, Guardiola asked him whether he missed returning to the Premier League and getting back the daily routine that comes with managing a club team .

The Argentine acknowledged that, although he was enjoying his experience with the United States, he missed the day-to-day training sessions, press conferences, and constant contact with his players . The national team schedule, with long stretches between training camps, had made him reconsider his professional priorities.

That conversation was one of the factors that helped him change his perspective and consider the possibility of returning to England. In the end, he accepted Manchester United's offer and left the American project behind. Now, as he prepares for his new adventure at Old Trafford, Pochettino points to Guardiola as the right man to continue his work with the national team .

articles.title: Pochettino declares himself ready for Manchester United after an emotional farewell to the United States
articles.standfirst: Christian Pulisic capped Mauricio Pochettino's final match as USMNT coach with a spectacular bicycle kick, sending the Americans into the Nations League Finals in style.
articles.summary: Christian Pulisic capped Mauricio Pochettino's final match as USMNT coach with a spectacular bicycle kick, sending the Americans into the Nations League Finals in style.
articles.body:
Christian Pulisic delivered a moment to remember with a spectacular bicycle kick as the United States Men's National Team defeated Haiti 2-0 on Tuesday night, giving Mauricio Pochettino a winning sendoff in the second leg of the Concacaf Nations League quarterfinals .

The Americans completed a dominant 8-0 aggregate victory , punching their ticket to the Concacaf Nations League Finals in Los Angeles next March while closing the curtain on Pochettino's successful two-year tenure before he officially takes over as Manchester United manager.

The 54-year-old Argentine received a warm ovation from the 24,001 fans at TQL Stadium, ending his spell with the United States on a high note. Pochettino begins his new role at Old Trafford on Wednesday after agreeing to replace Michael Carrick .

Several members of his coaching staff had already departed for England following Saturday's 6-0 first-leg victory , while assistant Miguel D'Agostino , fitness coach Sylvia Tuyà Viñas , and analyst Alex Scott remained for Tuesday's match before joining Pochettino in Manchester.

Pulisic steals the spotlight in Pochettino's farewell

Pulisic produced the night's signature moment in the 25th minute , connecting on a sensational bicycle kick after Weston McKennie floated a perfectly weighted cross into the penalty area.

The goal, Pulisic's 36th for the United States, gave him three goals across the two-leg series before he was substituted in the 65th minute .

Teenage forward Julian Hall sealed the victory in the 43rd minute, calmly controlling another McKennie assist before finishing past Haiti goalkeeper Alexandre Pierre. The goal was Hall's fifth in just six appearances for the senior national team.

Pochettino leaves USMNT after successful two-year spell

Pochettino finishes his U.S. tenure with a 23-12-2 recor d, highlighted by a run to the 2026 FIFA World Cup Round of 16 , where the Americans were eliminated by Belgium.

During his time in charge, 78 players earned national team caps, including 31 debutants , while nine teenagers made senior appearances, reinforcing the federation's long-term commitment to youth development.

With his focus now shifting to Manchester United , Pochettino will have only a few days to prepare his new squad before Sunday's Premier League showdown against Liverpool .

Even before kickoff, U.S. Soccer CEO JT Batson emphasized that the federation intends to pursue another elite manager capable of building on the foundation Pochettino leaves behind.

Pochettino himself even suggested Pep Guardiola as his ideal successor during a media roundtable on Monday.

“For us to win, we need to be great at a lot of things, and we need someone who cares about youth development, cares about our youth national team programs, our rel ationships with our clubs and the success of the federation more broadly,” Batson said. “We know that is a key part of our success, and it’s also a key part of how we’ve been able to attract great people because they get to do big things.”

articles.title: Rafa Márquez takes a weight off his shoulders with Tecatito Corona's goal: His cry of relief says it all!
articles.standfirst: He celebrated angrily the goal that secured El Tri's qualification against Jamaica
articles.summary: He celebrated angrily the goal that secured El Tri's qualification against Jamaica
articles.body:
These are complicated times for Rafa Márquez, who saved a "match ball" against Jamaica thanks to Tecatito Corona's great goal. The score did not change afterward, but the 1-0 was enough to reach the Concacaf Nations League semifinals and meet the bare minimum expected of El Tri in the competition.

Mexico's head coach knew a lot was at stake. An elimination against Jamaica would have been a historic embarrassment, and his continuity at the helm of the national team could truly have been in jeopardy. After the victory, the coach still faces strong criticism over the performance shown by his players in the tie, but at least he buys time to prepare for the semifinal against the United States in the next FIFA international window.

Tecatito Corona's wonder goal was a relief for Márquez, just as the TUDN cameras captured. The "Kaiser" turned on the touchline and let out a cry of rage while clenching his fists tightly and looking toward his bench. Afterwards, he seems to utter some kind of expletive, while raising his arms and urging the crowd to get behind them and cheer them on.

Márquez let go of all the tension: "I wanted to help the boys"

Then, he high-fived one of his assistants while the players hugged near his position. That was when Márquez tried to rein in his euphoria, aware that there was still a long way to go and the objective was by no means achieved.

"Today I also pushed myself to stay more on top of the player. I experienced the game intensely to try to help the boys," Márquez acknowledged in a press conference. It was not just any match for him.

articles.title: Rooney admits he thought about taking his own life while playing for Manchester United
articles.standfirst: The former footballer, 41, spoke about his problems with drinking and depression
articles.summary: The former footballer, 41, spoke about his problems with drinking and depression
articles.body:
Wayne Rooney, Manchester United and England legend, admitted that during his career he considered taking his own life.

The 41-year-old former footballer shared it on the podcast "Life at the Midpoint", where he spoke about his problems with alcohol, depression, and suicidal thoughts during his time at Manchester United.

"When I was drinking, I would lock myself in my house for two days and just drink. That was at the peak of my career," said Rooney.

"Now I think about it and see that I was selfish, but I was going through something that I was really struggling with. I tried to hide it all. I was at a point where you think about suicide. I didn’t want to be with anyone. I didn’t want to see people in the streets, I didn’t want to go into a shop. I was only comfortable on a football pitch, but everything else was very difficult for me," he explained.

In the interview, the former top scorer for the England national team admitted that he did not want to seek help because weaknesses had to be "masked" and that if he had done so, he would have felt "less of a man".

Now retired, Rooney is now one of the most respected television commentators, and he also writes opinion columns for the BBC.

articles.title: Pulisic bids farewell to Pochettino with a stunning bicycle kick goal: "It was very beautiful"
articles.standfirst: He opened the scoring against Haiti with an acrobatic finish: ""I had never scored one like that"
articles.summary: He opened the scoring against Haiti with an acrobatic finish: ""I had never scored one like that"
articles.body:
Christian Pulisic was the main star in Mauricio Pochettino's farewell match with the United States national team.

The AC Milan player opened the scoring with an overhead kick finish from McKennie's cross from the right. A beautifully crafted goal that, as he admitted in an interview after the match, he had never managed before.

"I had never scored a goal like that, it was special. Weston crossed the ball and it was the only thing I could really do, so I thought I had to try it. It was really beautiful to see the ball go into the net," he explained.

The USMNT star, who in the past had some run-ins with Mauricio Pochettino, spoke about the Argentine coach's departure from the United States national team. "Yes, obviously he's leaving now, so it's nice to close this chapter with a good performance and a good victory for the team," he summed up.

“We’re in a good moment. I mean, I think the team has improved. I think there’s a good culture within the group and I think we should really be focused on the future,” he said.

Pochettino's farewell message

Pulisic shared the coach's message in his last match with the USMNT. "Pochettino told us that we have a truly extraordinary team culture. We have built something very special and a bright future awaits us. And that we should keep it up, letting the rest of the team support us," he said.

"It’s very nice. It has been fun working with everyone. We’ve been able to get to know some of the new ones, as well as some young talent and, obviously, part of the same old group is still here. So it’s a really very good team. I really like where we are right now and I think we’re still growing and that a great future awaits us," he said.

Lastly, Pulisic spoke about the future head coach of the United States, a position that for the moment remains vacant, amid the rumors. "It's not that it doesn't matter. In the end, it's not our decision, the players'. We hope that whoever comes in knows how to make the most of the things we do very well and can guide us in a good direction," he said.

“We’re in a good moment. I mean, I think the team has improved. I think there’s a good culture within the group and I think we should really be focused on the future,” he said.
Pochettino's farewell message

Pulisic shared the coach's message in his last match with the USMNT. "Pochettino told us that we have a truly extraordinary team culture. We have built something very special and a bright future awaits us. And that we should keep it up, letting the rest of the team support us," he said.

In the end, it's not our decision, the players'. We hope that whoever comes in knows how to make the most of the things we do very well and can guide us in a good direction," he said.

articles.title: Messi's mother reveals her message to Nico Paz: "You are my son's successor"
articles.standfirst: Fabián Paz, Nico Paz's uncle, recounts the previously unreleased conversation between the Como footballer and Celia Cuccittini,
articles.summary: Fabián Paz, Nico Paz's uncle, recounts the previously unreleased conversation between the Como footballer and Celia Cuccittini,
articles.body:
The Canary Islander Nico Paz, a Como 1907 player whom Real Madrid could bring back with a unilateral 80 million euro clause, is making a case through his goals to become Leo Messi's successor with Argentina's iconic number 10.

Nico came out of the locker room and Messi's mother was there, emotional, crying. She took his hand and said to him: "You are my son's successor"

Fabián Paz, Nico Paz's uncle , revealed an unprecedented exchange between the Como footballer and Celia Cuccittini, Leo Messi's mother, after the 3-0 victory over Benin on October 6: "When I went to see him at Messi's farewell, Nico came out of the dressing room and Messi's mom was there, emotional, crying. Nico went over to greet her because he knew her, and she took his hand and said to him: "You are my son's successor"."

Nico's uncle stated on "Radio La Red" that the Real Madrid academy product came away "shocked" after Messi's mother's words in a moment that Nico Paz himself described as "very incredible" .

Nico Paz is not thinking about being Messi's successor

Fabián Paz, a well-known designer and founder of the "Atelier Pucheta" brand, shared that "Nico is a very calm and humble person. He does not have it in his head to be Messi's successor. For him, the greatest thing was meeting him and playing with Leo, and that was like touching the sky with his hands".

The designer emphasized about Nico Paz that "because he doesn’t live in Argentina, he doesn’t have as much pressure as other players. Here, football is experienced with a unique passion and madness, and he is still very surprised by that".

Nico Paz: "The truth is that I don't think about it (about inheriting Argentina's number 10 shirt)"

Nico Paz is the leading candidate to inherit the legendary number 10 shirt of the Albiceleste, previously worn by geniuses such as Leo Messi, Diego Armando Maradona, Mario Kempes, and Juan Román Riquelme.

"The truth is that I don't think about it (about inheriting the number 10 shirt), what I think about is enjoying days like today... Having fun on the pitch, because what I love most is playing football, and on top of that representing the national team and representing so many people... I play for that and I want to keep doing it," replied the former Madrid player, who played wearing number 18 and has scored four goals in just 48 days after finding the net against Bolivia, Burkina Faso, Benin and Costa Rica.

articles.title: McKennie shuts the door on a reunion with Pochettino: “I don’t plan to leave Juventus”
articles.standfirst: The American midfielder puts the brakes on rumors linking him with Manchester United under Mauricio Pochettino
articles.summary: The American midfielder puts the brakes on rumors linking him with Manchester United under Mauricio Pochettino
articles.body:
The arrival of Mauricio Pochettino to the bench of Manchester United unleashed a wave of speculation about possible signings from the international market and from the U.S. national team . However, the main figure himself has taken it upon himself to put out the media fires with a firm stance on his continuity in Serie A.

Rumors of an imminent change of scenery gained momentum in recent days, placing Old Trafford as the most likely destination for Weston McKennie due to the excellent relationship he has with the Argentine strategist . Despite reports from European media pointing to real interest from the Red Devils ahead of the winter transfer window, the player's response has been direct and left no room for doubt.

The hope of Old Trafford and the Pochettino factor

The appointment of Mauricio Pochettino by Manchester United immediately raised expectations of a profound overhaul of the English squad . Various international media outlets reported that the Argentine coach had the Juventus defensive midfielder among his absolute priorities to provide intensity and versatility in midfield for the Manchester side.

The mutual understanding acquired during their time in charge of the United States national team fueled speculation about a possible reunion in the Premier League . Transfer market analysts pointed out that United’s urgency to climb positions in the English standings heightened the need to bring in players with international pedigree and accustomed to top-level competition.

Despite this scenario, the speculation began to lose steam when outlets such as TodoMercadoWeb and sports news networks reminded that the Turin club has no intention of parting with one of its tactical pillars in the middle of the season .

The American's weight in Turin and his renewal

Weston McKennie's refusal to heed siren calls from England is grounded in his current status within the Turin institution . Under the guidance of the coaching staff, the midfielder has established himself as an extremely valuable asset thanks to his physical presence, ability to get into the box, and versatility to occupy multiple positions on the pitch.

This prominence was recently reaffirmed when the player extended his contractual ties with the Italian giant until June 2030 . As reported by Fútbol Centroamérica, that renewal grants both the club and the player absolute stability, putting to rest the specter of a hasty departure in the short term.

Faced with persistent media pressure, the midfielder himself put the debate to rest by publicly expressing his happiness in Italy. "I want to make it clear that I do not plan to leave Juventus" , he stated emphatically, adding that the decision to sign a new contract stems from a genuine desire to succeed in the long term at the Allianz Stadium.

Complex outlook for the English giant

While the American international secures his commitment to the Vecchia Signora, Manchester United’s sporting management will have to explore different alternatives on their agenda to strengthen a squad going through a demanding stretch of the season . Reports coming out of Italy and specialized outlets such as TuttoJuve confirm that any formal attempt by the English side would have run into an impenetrable wall in Turin.

Juventus, immersed in the battle for UEFA Champions League qualification spots and strengthening its tactical approach , considers the midfielder an untouchable piece to maintain competitive balance . Thus, the much-desired reunion between the Argentine strategist and his pupil in the Premier League will have to wait, while the player remains focused on his league commitments in Serie A.

articles.title: The main reason why Pochettino left the USMNT to take a gamble on Manchester United
articles.standfirst: The Argentine strategist decided to bring his time with the United States national team to an end in order to take charge at Old Trafford, seeking to satisfy an insatiable competitive ambition
articles.summary: The Argentine strategist decided to bring his time with the United States national team to an end in order to take charge at Old Trafford, seeking to satisfy an insatiable competitive ambition
articles.body:
Mauricio Pochettino did not want to waste a single second after ending his spell in charge of the U.S. national team , where he left a positive impression but with the lingering frustration of seeking a project of the highest constant demands . The South American coach accepted the call from the Red Devils , drawn by the magnitude of the institutional and media challenge that Old Trafford currently represents.

The sudden departure from the United States bench to Manchester has sparked all kinds of reactions on the international stage, opening a debate about the true motivations of the former Tottenham and Chelsea manager. While specialized outlets such as Goal and OneFootball highlight the Argentine's urgency to roll up his sleeves at Carrington , analysts at ESPN and Mundo Deportivo underscore the enormous risk he is taking at a club mired in a deep crisis of sporting results .

The context in which this move is taking shape responds to a perfect storm at the Theatre of Dreams, where Michael Carrick's dismissal left a huge void on the bench . The executives of the English club moved quickly to secure a manager with charisma, capable of withstanding the media pressure and steering back on course a squad that is sitting far from the top spots in the Premier League.

Pochettino, for his part, felt that the dugout of a national team offered a calm incompatible with his daily hunger for competitive adrenaline . British media and international broadcasters have pointed out that the coach missed the intensity of day-to-day life , the management of complex dressing rooms, and the demand of competing for titles every weekend.

The call of the Premier and the farewell to North America

Pochettino's farewell to the United States national team was made official after a victory over Haiti in the CONCACAF Nations League, a proper ending that nevertheless left the feeling that his spell could have encompassed much more . Outlets such as Goal reported that the coach took a night flight immediately after that match ended in Cincinnati to land in Britain in the early hours of the morning.

During his farewell on American soil, the strategist acknowledged that the affection of the people was immense, noting with a smile that in every corner of North America there is an absolute devotion to Manchester United . That global footprint of the English club ended up winning over a coach who has always known how to connect with the masses and who now needed a project with worldwide impact.

The pressure of Old Trafford and the antidote to routine

Trading the relative calm of national teams for the cauldron of Old Trafford means accepting fierce scrutiny from the press and from a fanbase desperate to reclaim glory . Outlets such as OneFootball and ESPN have emphasized that Pochettino was deliberately seeking this highest-pressure setting to prove to himself that he still belongs among the world’s elite managers .

The Argentine coach is aware that he inherits a dressing room that is emotionally battered and burdened by structural problems accumulated over several seasons. However, far from being intimidated, his remarks upon arriving at Carrington were charged with tremendous ambition, stating that they have not come to waste time and that Manchester's sleeping giant must wake up as soon as possible .

A direct challenge to the noisy neighbor and an eye on the future

In his first public appearances already on English soil, reported by newspapers such as Sport and various television networks, Pochettino made it clear that he is not afraid of Manchester City's recent dominance . In response to the joking remarks of former footballers about the city's color, the Rosario native replied firmly, asking for time to change the local hegemony and paint the city red again .

The project's major objective is to stabilize the team's overall performance and instill a recognizable tactical identity from its debut against Liverpool . The board has full confidence in his indomitable character to restore hope to a club that cannot afford another year of inconsistency, thus marking the beginning of an era in which Pochettino is staking a large part of his international prestige .

articles.title: Da'Vian Kimbrough explains why he chose to play for Mexico and not the USA: "I feel I made a good decision"
articles.standfirst: He will compete in the U-17 World Cup representing the country of origin of his maternal grandfather
articles.summary: He will compete in the U-17 World Cup representing the country of origin of his maternal grandfather
articles.body:
D a'Vian Kimbrough was able to choose between the Mexico and United States national teams and chose El Tri to compete in the U-17 World Cup being held these days in Qatar. The player from North Texas SC, an MLS NEXT Pro team and affiliate of FC Dallas , was born and raised in California , but he is the son of J essica Cervantes, a citizen of Mexican origin.

When it came time to make the decision, Kimbrough chose the country of origin of his mother's family, who are from Michoacán. "It is a great source of pride to be on the national team, especially to represent my family, who are also Mexican . It is a great honor to have two nationalities, Mexican and American, but I chose to represent Mexico and I feel that I made a good decision ," he told the Mexican Football Federation.

" I feel like I am definitely representing him, and it is also a great pride to represent everyone else in Mexico,” he explained. "Growing up with him, whether it was watching Liga MX matches or eating the food he prepares, traditional dishes, that is where a large part of my cultural heritage comes from," he said on one occasion in an interview.

Da"Vian Kimbrough is facing a great opportunity to confirm that we are looking at one of the great Concacaf soccer talents of the next decade. "I would like to show that I am a good forward who can score many goals and help the team win. In these major tournaments there is a high level, and I think that pushes me to improve," he said.

Mexico will face Romania (November 21), Cameroon (November 24), and Venezuela (November 27) in the first phase of the tournament, while the United States will play against Montenegro (November 21), Chile (November 24), and Algeria (November 27).

If both teams qualify, they could meet in the knockout stage and play a very special match for Kimbrough.

articles.title: Players and fans run for cover as gunfire disrupts Mexican baseball game
articles.summary: A Mexican professional baseball game turned into a frightening scene Friday night after gunfire and armed clashes near the stadium forced officials to suspend play, sending players, coaches and spectators scrambling for safety. The Mexican Pacific League matchup between the Algodoneros de Guasave and the Venados de Mazatlán at Kuroda Park in Guasave, Sinaloa, was halted during the top of the third inning as violence erupted in the surrounding area. Players and umpires abandoned their positions as shots rang out nearby, while fans rushed for cover, taking shelter in stadium tunnels and aisles. The game was stopped with pitcher Víctor Buelna preparing to deliver a pitch to Andrés Álvarez. The violence that disrupted the baseball game was part of a wider security crisis in northern Sinaloa. The state’s Ministry of Public Security confirmed that federal personnel had come under armed attack in Guasave on Friday, prompting the deployment of an interagency security operation.

As the Portuguese superstar left his club’s facilities and headed toward the team bus, he was seen asking the crowd if anyone wanted an autograph. articles.title: CAS 'restores' the Africa Cup to Senegal... and Morocco lights up
articles.standfirst: Confirms Mané's team's victory in the 2025 edition
articles.summary: Confirms Mané's team's victory in the 2025 edition
articles.body:
The CAS (Court of Arbitration for Sport) has ruled that it "returns" the 2025 Africa Cup to Senegal, overturning the decision CAF made in March and thus confirming what happened on the field: the Senegalese victory by 0-1. This CAS decision has angered Morocco, which yesterday, as we reported in MARCA , was expecting "99.9%" a favorable ruling from CAS. That has not been the case in the end.

"The Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) has upheld the appeal filed by the Senegalese Football Federation (FSF) against the Confederation of African Football (CAF) and the Royal Moroccan Football Federation (FRMF, in French) regarding the final of the Morocco 2025 Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON 2025). The decision issued by the CAF Appeals Board is set aside and the decision of the CAF Disciplinary Board is reinstated . Consequently, the result obtained at the end of the AFCON 2025 final is confirmed (1-0 in favor of Senegal) ", states the official statement.

Let us remember that in mid-March, the CAF stripped Senegal of the title, which it had won in January’s grand final thanks to a goal by Pape Gueye (0-1) in extra time. Then came the complaints from the Moroccan Federation, claiming that the "Lions of Teranga", during extra time, had abandoned the match after the referee awarded a dubious penalty in favor of Morocco, which Brahim took "Panenka-style" after the match had been stopped for 15 minutes due to the Senegalese walk-off. BD missed it and Senegal ultimately won the match.

"If, for any reason, a team refuses to play or leaves the field of play before the regulation end of the match without the referee's authorization, it shall be considered the loser and will be eliminated from the ongoing competition," established Article 82 of the CAN. By virtue of that article, CAF automatically overturned the result and awarded Morocco a 0-3 win last March. Now CAS has once again ruled in Senegal's favor.

After that 3-0 decided off the pitch, Senegal , as could not have been otherwise, submitted allegations to retain the title and appealed the decision imposed to the CAS . "I t is unfair, unprecedented and unacceptable ," its Federation went so far as to say, which now sees how the CAS proves it right.

Throughout all these months, the Superior Court of Sports Arbitration has studied the case, and abandoning the field is not legal grounds to award the title to Morocco, so Senegal keeps the crown won on the pitch. The controversy will continue with this 2025 Cup.

articles.title: Does Guardiola give hope to the USMNT?: “A national team is my next step”
articles.standfirst: The Catalan strategist publicly acknowledged that his biggest unfinished business on the bench is managing a national team
articles.summary: The Catalan strategist publicly acknowledged that his biggest unfinished business on the bench is managing a national team
articles.body:
Pep Guardiola surprised with remarks about his future as a coach and left open the possibility of managing a national team . His words come at a time when the United States is looking for a new head coach following the departure of Mauricio Pochettino , so his name is once again gaining momentum.

The Catalan coach spoke about his plans during an interview with former Brazilian footballer Romário , in which he acknowledged that, when he decides to return to the dugout, he would like to take on a different challenge from club football . “A national team” would be his next step, a possibility he had not specified until now.

The statement did not go unnoticed, especially given the context the USMNT is going through. The U.S. national team needs to find a new head coach, and Guardiola appears among the names that have sparked interest and speculation . However, his words do not represent a confirmation that he is going to take over the position in the United States .

Guardiola eyes managing a national team

According to The Guardian, the 55-year-old coach stated that his next professional experience will be in charge of a national team , although he still is not sure when he will work again. After a decade at the helm of Manchester City, Guardiola decided to take a break and temporarily step away from the daily demands of football .

The strategist also explained the reasons why he turned down the possibility of managing Italy. Guardiola confirmed that he held talks with the Italian federation and acknowledged that receiving that offer was one of the greatest honors of his career . However, he felt that it was not the right time to accept the challenge, since he needed time for himself .

“If it had happened one or two years earlier, I probably would have accepted” , the Catalan explained about Italy’s interest. In that same conversation, he made it clear that he is in no rush to return and that his decision will depend on how he feels when the time comes to coach again.

The United States appears among Pep's possible destinations

Guardiola’s name began to be linked with the USMNT after Mauricio Pochettino left the position to begin a new chapter at Manchester United . According to information published by The Guardian, the Spanish coach has been mentioned among the possible candidates to take charge of the U.S. bench , although there is still no agreement or confirmation of negotiations.

Sports Illustrated had also reported on US Soccer’s interest in finding out the coach’s availability, although it noted that his camp was not considering interrupting the rest period . For now, the fact that Guardiola wants to manage a national team does not necessarily mean that the United States is his chosen destination.

Pochettino opens the door for the Catalan coach

One of the details fueling th e possibility of seeing Guardiola at the helm of the United States are Pochettino's own words . Before leaving the American national team, the Argentine was asked what advice he would give the Spaniard if he received an offer to take over his position, and his response was emphatic: he would recommend accepting .

Pochettino believes that the United States is going through a good moment to build a competitive project and that it has players capable of adapting to Guardiola’s philosophy. Nevertheless, the Catalan coach maintains his stance of taking some time away from football and has not set a date for his return. “I don’t know how long I’ll be away. Right now I feel very good” , he explained.

Therefore, Guardiola’s statements represent an important sign of the direction he wants to take in his career, but not a promise for U.S. soccer. The USMNT now has the opportunity to seek a top-level coach , although convincing the former Barcelona, Bayern Munich, and Manchester City manager will depend both on the project and on his willingness to return to the sidelines .

Even at 41, Cristiano Ronaldo's competitive spirit hasn't lost an ounce of intensity! The Portuguese superstar was facing Al Sadd in the Asian Champions League when an offside decision sparked his frustration.

Ronaldo had already scored his 987th career goal that night, moving just 13 away from the historic milestone. His team eventually secured a 2 to 1 victory thanks to a spectacular bicycle kick from João Félix.

But Ronaldo's reaction has sparked controversy over his treatment of the officials. Even on a winning night, Cristiano wants every decision to go his way!

articles.title: Will Dani Alves return to prison? Spain’s Supreme Court to decide on Dec. 1 whether to overturn acquittal
articles.standfirst: The high court will deliberate next December 1 on the appeals filed by the Public Prosecutor's Office and the private prosecution
articles.summary: The high court will deliberate next December 1 on the appeals filed by the Public Prosecutor's Office and the private prosecution
articles.body:
The judicial future of Dani Alves once again takes center stage. The Criminal Chamber of the Supreme Court will meet next Tuesday, December 1, to deliberate and rule on the cassation appeals filed against the judgment that acquitted the former footballer of the crime of sexual assault for which he was convicted at first instance.

The decision comes after both the Public Prosecutor's Office and the private prosecution challenged the ruling issued in March 2025 by the High Court of Justice of Catalonia (TSJC). In that decision, the Catalan court unanimously overturned the four-and-a-half-year prison sentence that the Barcelona Court had previously imposed on the former Brazilian player, alleging insufficient evidence and the primacy of the right to the presumption of innocence.

The arguments before the high court

In their appeal before the Supreme Court, the Public Prosecutor's Office and the complainant's defense argue that the High Court of Justice of Catalonia made a “non-rational” and arbitrary assessment of all the evidence presented during the trial. Among the key points of the challenge is the questioning of the young woman's testimony, who suffered a traumatic freeze response during the events that took place in a Barcelona nightclub in December 2022, as well as the interpretation of the biological traces found at the scene.

What could happen starting Tuesday?

The deliberation, with magistrate Andrés Martínez Arrieta acting as rapporteur, will mark a definitive turning point in the process, although with clear procedural limits. As this is the review of an acquittal, the Supreme Court does not have the authority to directly issue a new conviction against Alves .

In this way, if the high court upholds the appeals, it will overturn the acquittal by the High Court of Justice of Catalonia and order the case to be returned so that a differently composed court can issue a new ruling in accordance with the law. On the contrary, if it decides to dismiss them and endorses the criteria of the Catalan courts, Dani Alves’s acquittal will become final once and for all.
